findings.desc: Coverage exercises captureMilestoneCloseoutSnapshotFromStore directly, but no test or smoke asserts the real story_advance --phase=DONE path writes milestone-closeout.json. A regression that removes the transition-orchestrator DONE wiring at packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:600 would leave the focused milestone-status tests green. Add an end-to-end or smoke test with a TEST story and confirmed ledger that runs story_advance DONE and asserts the closeout snapshot is captured before phase metadata/drift.
findings.resolvedReason: Added packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs regression using createStoryAdvanceHandlers(...).story_advance from a temp TEST story to DONE. It asserts milestone-closeout.json is persisted through transition-orchestrator wiring, the capture log appears, the story reaches DONE, and the snapshot phase remains TEST before DONE metadata persistence. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run build, node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs, and lattice validate --story=B-bfba --json passing all 33 configured commands.
